evidence.title: Spectrum-Aware Bounds on Invertibility for Privacy-Enhancing Instance Encoding

summary: Researchers have derived spectrum-aware mathematical bounds that characterize how easily encoded data can be reversed, shedding light on the limits of privacy-preserving instance encoding techniques. The findings help guide the design of more robust privacy mechanisms by quantifying trade‑offs between utility and invertibility.
title: New Study Provides Spectrum-Aware Bounds on Invertibility of Privacy-Enhancing Instance Encoding
